description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Recent Sequence Ratio and two metrics: Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio. The x-axis represents the Recent Sequence Ratio (%), with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The left y-axis represents Perplexity, with a linear scale, ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1, while the right y-axis represents GPU Memory Ratio (%), with a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 100, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot displays four lines: Perplexity (orange, solid line, circle markers), Full Cache PPL (red, dashed line), GPU Memory Ratio (blue, solid line, circle markers), and Full Cache GPU Memory (blue, dashed line). The Perplexity line starts at approximately 4.6 at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 10%, decreases to around 4.3 at 40%, and then gradually increases to about 4.35 at 100%. The Full Cache PPL line remains relatively constant at around 4.4 across the x-axis range. The GPU Memory Ratio line starts at around 45% at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 10%, increases steadily to about 60% at 80%, and then sharply rises to 100% at 100%. The Full Cache GPU Memory line remains constant at 60% across the x-axis range.
